name: mergerfs Open-Source Union Filesystem
free_limit: ISC-licensed Linux FUSE union filesystem that combines multiple existing storage paths into one logical mount; no software license fee or vendor usage quota.
watch_out: Runs on user-managed Linux storage and requires compatible FUSE/kernel configuration; physical disks, backups and infrastructure cost extra. It is NOT RAID, parity protection, redundancy or a backup solution; retain license notice.
